hypotheses.title: Options Synthetic Forward Price Carry Premium
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Synthetic forward price (forward_price_150) derived from ATM options put-call parity reflects institutional term-structure demand and net carry. The relative basis (forward_price_150 - close) / close captures positive forward cost of carry and institutional demand for upside exposure. Equities with elevated synthetic forward carry systematically outperform as institutional expectations are realized in cash markets. A 15-day linear decay dampens turnover while preserving cross-sectional signal rank.
confounders: Unusually high borrowing fees (hard-to-borrow stocks) artificially inflating synthetic forward price
Large upcoming ex-dividend dates distorting forward pricing
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during severe market deleveraging regimes where hard-to-borrow stocks collapse despite high forward basis.

hypotheses.title: Put-Call Open Interest Contrarian Hedging Exhaustion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The 20-day put-to-call open interest ratio (pcr_oi_20) measures institutional downside hedging pressure across options markets. Abnormally elevated put positioning within a subindustry signals excessive panic hedging and oversold conditions where downside risk is over-discounted. As hedging demand subsides, equities with top-percentile put open interest mean-revert strongly upward, capturing a contrarian sentiment premium.
confounders: Genuine impending balance-sheet bankruptcy or catastrophic litigation justifying high put open interest
Passive index rebalancing across options strikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during systemic default spirals where distressed equities with high put open interest continue downward into restructuring.

hypotheses.title: Call Breakeven Upside Distance Channel Expansion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Open-interest weighted call breakeven (call_breakeven_150) identifies where institutional call buyers anticipate equity price appreciation by expiration. Equities with large percentage distance to call breakeven (call_breakeven_150 - close) / close reflect wide upside gamma channels and aggressive bullish positioning by sophisticated counterparties, delivering sustained risk-adjusted excess returns over constrained peers.
confounders: Speculative far-out-of-the-money retail call buying on low-quality meme stocks
Earnings volatility spikes causing temporary option premium inflation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during broad market drawdowns where far-OTM calls expire worthless without spot convergence.
